TZ-TFCT.spreadsheetRightsQualification: A separate XLS-specific license was not observed without opening originals. Conservatively retain the accompanying book restrictions for all companion sheets until scope is verified.
TZ-TFCT.exactCommercialRestriction: No part of this document should be copied and distributed for commercial purpose without the permission of the authors.
TZ-TFCT.restrictionScopeQualification: The text expressly addresses copying and distribution for commercial purpose. It does not separately mention downloading, private archival custody or an undistributed private copy within a commercial project. Consequently this review does not claim that the publisher explicitly forbids every private download. Nor does public availability establish that OffMenu has a qualifying public-health purpose or commercial-copy permission. The acquisition hold is a conservative unresolved-purpose/permission classification, not an observed publisher denial of an ordinary private GET.
